args.summary: checkout-api deploy v2.3.1 began failing health checks in production (error rate ~18%) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. SRE rolled the service back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent version previously healthy in production. Post-rollback status checked and reported. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy; note the release has not been shown healthy in production and change-manager approval will be required to redeploy it.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy on v2.3.1 - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 (unhealthy in production, ~18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent version that was healthy in production — in all three regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 with a normal error rate (~0.2%).
4. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** describing the failure and the rollback, and paged the on-call engineer.

Note: if the team wants to redeploy v2.3.1 later, it has never been healthy in production, so it will require change-manager approval per policy.
